title: Maintenance by mileage
purpose: Public explanation of oil service, filters and the 30/60/90K service.
facts: Intervals are the trade's rule of thumb; the owner's manual wins.
"Tune-up" in customers' words = spark plugs, filters and an inspection.
Courtesy inspection is free with every service; three states shown to the customer as green, yellow, red (ERP inspection_item: good, watch, bad).

rows.What: Full synthetic oil and filter, $90.95. Tire rotation every other time
Engine air filter and cabin air filter. We show you the old one before we change it
Scheduled maintenance service: inspect, adjust and lubricate by the maker's list
Spark plugs, coolant, transmission fluid, drive belt
Timing belt. Not every engine has one; many have a chain that is not serviced

new_facts: Interval table (5,000-7,500 miles oil; 15-30K filters; 30K scheduled service; brake fluid 2-3 years; 60-100K plugs, coolant, ATF, belt; about 100K timing belt). Reason: needed for the page; standard advice, no catalogue row.

notes_for_russian_writer: Russian intervals in km: oil every 7 500 to 10 000 km (older parc, short trips), scheduled ТО every 15 000 km. "Tune-up" has no Russian twin; use «ТО» and what customers call «плановое ТО».
